items.item_text: In this position, you will perform duties as a Central Service Technician Tech ll, (CSTll) supporting the Uniform Distribution Department, assisting the Laundry and Linen Department along with the Materials Management Department as needed. This role directly supports the distribution of the UCLA Uniforms Department across RRH, SMH, West Valley and outside clinics. Work assignments are prioritized and carried out in alignment with the departmental goals, operational needs.

The Central Service Technician is responsible for maintain accurate and efficient inventory management across assigned locations. Core responsibilities include but not limited to, setting appointments, processing uniform order requests, overseeing the Nursing uniform ordering site and 3rd party website, placing supply orders, to replenish inventory levels, monitoring supply utilization trends, and evaluating inventory turns to proactively adjust par levels to meet fluctuating demands. The CSTll plays a key role in maintaining efficient par management processes to ensure appropriate stock levels are maintained while minimizing supply shortages or overstock conditions.

Additional responsibilities include receiving, verifying, and distributing incoming supplies and equipment thought the health system. This includes packing slips with delivered designated storage and procedural areas in a safe and timely manner.
Strictly obeys the healthcare regulations for infection control
Consistently adheres to Material Management / Receiving and UCLA Policies and procedures
Actively participates in Quality Management and PIE programs

Consistently maintains good guest relations interdepartmentally, intra-departmentally, using English language in both written and verbal format. Demonstrate good telephone etiquette. Is sensitive to co-works, patients, and family members in a courteous and respectful manner.
Always responds to the needs of all areas. If unable to meet the needs, keeps the area informed and offers alternatives
Will actively assist in meeting the needs to the department
Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with staff and sales reps
Attends all in-services/workshops as requested. Assist in the orientation and skill development of new staff members.
Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize assignments
Ability to push, pull up to 100 pounds and lift up to 50 pounds
Skill in efficiently and accurately facilitating the appointment making process, including follow up emails
Ability to use Personal Computers, Supply Dollies, Heavy duty transport carts, Phones, Fax machines, Copy machine
Ability to work 3rd party uniform website
Ability to work the Uniform ordering system
